notes.title: AI Excercise - Patch 1.4.0 is out now!
notes.content:
Patch 1.4.0 brings improvements to enemy behavior that will make them move more and a bit smarter and well as balancing changes to even things out.

[h3]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Melee enemies are now strafing more and will periodically retreat from the player.
[*] Increased minimal distance to player a bit so they won't feel like they are cliping through that much.
[*] Ranged enemies have more consistent and longer repositioning and are slowly backpedalling when player is too close to them.
[/list]
[h3]BALANCE CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased certain enemies melee attack range to compensate for greater minimal distance to player.
[*] Increased players attack range a bit.
[*] Reduced all enemy damage by ~10%.
[*] Increased attack windup for Skelemental and Knightmare's shadow bolt.
[*] Added 0.2s global cooldown for enemy attacks.
[*] Frostbolt damage type changed from point to small aoe (akin to Fireball).
[*] Fireball and Frostbolt now have slight homing capabilities (you do need to have the crosshair on the enemy at the time of the cast).
[*] Boogieman can now move while throwing pumpkins.
[/list]
[h3]VISUAL CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased camera shake when player is hitting enemies with the sword.
[*] Added camera shake when fireball or frostbolt hits an enemy.
[*] Added small glow on collectibles to increase visibility.
[*] Added small light to memoralias so they are easier to spot.
[/list]
[h3]FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed collision inside a pool in ruins on Broken Village (Werewolf is no longer stuck there).
[*] Moved Werewolf memoralia on Broken Village so its easier to spot.
[*] Hitting world objects will no longer produce multiple hit sounds.
[/list]

notes.title: Lichenvale Demo Available
notes.content:
Lichenvale is hitting one year anniversary and I have decided to re-release the demo to the public.
You'll be able to fight your way through the first level, collecting powerups, memoralias and lore books as they are in the main game, no alterations whatsoever! Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Power Overwhelming - Patch 1.3.0 is out now!
notes.content:
Player feedback is really important and I've decided to implement some balancing changes in regards to it. Patch 1.3.0 brings new features, balance changes and bugfixes.

[h3]FEATURES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Red Power Orb now additionally gives permanent 10% additive melee damage increase per pickup.
[*] Purple Power Orb now additionally  gives permanent 10% additive spell damage increase per pickup.

    (There are in total 5 power orbs of each type across levels for total of 50% increased melee & spell damage. Existing saves will have these bonuses applied!)
[/list]
[h3]BALANCE CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the amount of enemies across levels 4-6.
[*] Increased spawn delays of enemies across levels 4-6.
[*] Added more health potions across levels 4-6.
[*] Added Red and Purple Power Orbs on level 4.
[*] Increased cooldown of Werewolf Brute's pounce and bite attacks.
[*] Increased Medusa's health by 100.
[*] Increased Skeleton King's health by 200.
[*] Fireball's radius is slightly increased.
[/list]
[h3]FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where player would start new level on normal difficulty with 50% health at most.
[*] Fixed an issue where player would get stuck in spike / lava pits with no way out.
[*] Enemies will no longer get confused when coming from out of bounds areas on level 4.
[/list]

notes.title: Difficulty settings is out now! - Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
Patch 1.2.0 brings difficulty settings as well as some bug fixes.

[h3]FEATURES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added difficulty settings, players can choose from following:
[list]
    [*] INITIATE: Enemies take 33% more damage, deal 33% damage less and are 10% slower (both movement and attacks). Health potions heal for 33% more. Player starts with 5 lives.
    [*] ADEPT: Everything is at a baseline. Player starts with 3 lives.
    [*] MASTER: Enemies take 33% damage less, deal 33% damage more and are 10% faster (both movement and attacks). Health potions heal for 33% less. Player starts with 1 life.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where player could get 255 lives when doing save / load when dying and 0 lives left.
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters would have 0 health and be alive on load after saving while the death animation is playing.
[/list]

notes.title: Reworked death system is out now! - Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Patch 1.1.0 brings new features, balance changes and bugfixes!

[h3]FEATURES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked death system. Player now begins the game with 3 lives and gains one per every 50k points collected. Upon losing a life player will gain invulnerability for 2 seconds, have his health fully restored while losing 50% of current mana. All monsters on the level will have their health fully restored. When all lives are lost it is game over and you can continue from your latest save game.
[*] Added level ending screen which shows the player how many monsters he have slained, how many loot, memoralia and powerups he has collected and how many lore books has he read.
[*] Added high score leaderboard. High score is posted when player finishes the game or loses all lives.
[*] Added Audio options page
[*] Added pickup sound for loot and memoralia
[/list]

[h3]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Immortal achievement which is unlocked after player finishes the game without dying once.
[/list]

[h3]LOCALIZATION[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Catalan localization
[/list]

[h3]TWEAKS AND FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased base mana generation rate by 15%
[*] Increased monster infighting chance from 20% to 25%
[*] Slightly increased attack range for most ranged enemies
[*] Increased Boogieman's melee attack range
[*] Reduced Boogieman's time between attacks
[*] Reduced Boogieman's drumming time
[*] Boogieman now restores to full health after player death
[*] Fixed Boogieman missing his melee attacks while being hit
[*] Knightmare Lord now restores to full health after player death
[*] Fixed Knightmare Lord doing damage only on his first spin instance
[*] Fixed some invisible walls on Broken Village
[*] Fixed player landing sound playing indefinitely when being semi-stuck
[*] Fixed combat music not playing properly when loading a save game on Lepteria
[*] Fixed skull doors not playing opening sounds on Necropolis
[*] Fixed end level statue having its glow but Skeleton King is not defeated after loading save on Necropolis
[/list]

notes.title: Lichenvale OST is now available for purchase!
notes.content:
The Lichenvale original soundtrack, composed by Branislav Gagic, takes you on a journey through dark fantasy worlds of nightmares - through twisted forests, ancient dungeons, haunted graveyards, snowy ravines, and more.

The soundtrack contains 11 tracks, including one track not used in the game. All proceeds from the soundtrack go to the composer.

All tracks are available in both 320kbps MP3 and lossless WAV format.

TOTAL RUN TIME: 63 minutes.

Check it out here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2407510/Lichenvale_Original_Soundtrack]Lichenvale OST[/url]

notes.title: Lichenvale Alpha Demo
notes.content:
Hello all, thank you for your interest in Lichenvale. Finally you'll be able to see for yourself what it's going to look like, or more precisely, what it looks like in alpha state. Should be very stable, but as always, you're testing at your own risk. This public alpha demo is gonna be available for a limited time only, from Feb the 1st to 15th, so act now, download, play and don't forget to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1432380/discussions/0/3109141414218598618/]leave feedback[/url]. I am really looking forward to your thoughts and opinions. Yes, you're allowed to stream or record videos for your YouTube channel, just please post a link in the feedback thread as I'd love to see it too.  

Since the first closed alpha build I've been working hard at making the second level and improving general feel and mechanics. Enemies were overhauled completely as I dropped the usage of free Paragon assets in favor of licensed ones that are more fit to my vision. Second level, the Old Ruins, features new enemies, secrets, some light puzzling and new power-ups to help you fend off the nightmarish fiends. During the closed testing I have balanced out the combat and made some improvements. You now wield your sword in your right hand and spells in your left hand, which allows for more fluid and fun combat. Some of the new enemies have some special trick to them, such as Knightmare which is invulnerable to damage while not attacking. Monsters now have a chance to start infighting if they are not careful and get into friendly fire a bit too much.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O65aSHYaXEY

For this public event, I've added a short tutorial that should help inexperienced melee players with the basic commands. You can skip it, but it's not recommended and trust me, it's very short so you won't spend more than a few minutes there. Also, if you reach the 2nd level, your progress will be autosaved and you'll be able to use the continue feature from the main menu later, to continue from the beginning of that level.

I hope you have fun and don't forget to let me know how you liked it. Thanks for your time!
